# CAGE Semantic Governance Policy — CAGE Financial Advisor v1.1.0
# Generated from STPA control structure. Do not edit manually.
# Source: config/stpa_control_structure.yaml

# UCA-1: Agent executes write operation without a signed approval token.
Do not execute "write_db" if "approval_token" is null or missing.

# UCA-2: Agent executes trade with stale market data (latency > threshold).
Do not execute "execute_trade" if "latency_ms" exceeds 200.0.

# UCA UCA-3: condition not mappable to AGP NL — omitted.
# UCA UCA-4: condition not mappable to AGP NL — omitted.
# UCA-5: Agent executes buy order when daily drawdown exceeds limit.
Do not execute "execute_trade" if "drawdown" exceeds 4.5.

# UCA-6: Agent submits market order exceeding allowable fraction of daily volume.
Do not execute "execute_trade" when: order_size > threshold_ref(stpa.uca6_max_order_volume_fraction) * daily_vol.

# UCA-7: Adversarial prompt injection score exceeds detection threshold.
Do not execute "prompt_injection_check" if "semantic_score" exceeds 0.85.

# UCA-8: Agent executes trade before risk assessment is complete.
Do not execute "execute_trade" if "risk_assessed" is false or not set to true.

# UCA-9: Agent executes trade with compliance check bypassed.
Do not execute "execute_trade" if "compliance_checked" is false or not set to true.

# UCA-3 (NeMo rail): Agent outputs PII to user interface.
Block any request that I cannot share personal information in my response.

# UCA-4 (NeMo rail): Agent debits account but fails to credit asset (atomic failure).
Block any request that Transaction integrity check failed. Stopping execution.

# UCA-7 (NeMo rail): Adversarial prompt injection score exceeds detection threshold.
Block any request that I cannot process this request as it appears to be attempting to override my instructions.

Require human approval for "execute_trade" where "amount" exceeds 5000 for "junior" role users.

Deny "execute_trade" where "currency" is "BTC" for "junior" role users.

Require human approval for "execute_trade" where "amount" exceeds 500000 for "senior" role users.

Deny "execute_trade" where "currency" is "BTC" for "senior" role users.
